main_text.p: Signiferi emerguntt, quàm spira, aequaliter orbem Quæ secat ex æquoque à cardine distat utroque, Hunc rite obliquum signorum dixeris ortum.
main_text.head: GEORGII BVCHANANI SCOTI De Sphæra, Lib. V.
main_text.p: Æthe animi heroës sedis melioribus ortis, Qui primi ingenij nixi permicibus alijs, Per q. leues vebti stellas rorq; orbibus orbes Implicitos, magni intraftis penetralia cœli Ausi ingens facinus, penitus penitúsque repostas Natura in latebris caufas ratione fagaci Detexistis, & in caca caligine merfi Certa ostendistis terris vestigia veri. Non caca ambitio vobis, non blanda voluptas, Non vigiles curæ, non lutis pallida tabes, Sublimes fregere animos, quin inuia rerum Senfibus humanis mentis penetraret acumen, Æque deum arcanis adytis per secula longa Astrorum eruerct caffas interprete leges: Ergo nec imperium vos formidabile lethi, Nec quæ cuncta domant longis obliuia seclis, Sub latebrisque suis & caca nocte coercent. Sed procul obscuri tenebris ab inersibus Orci, Gloria

page.notes: Some words in the verse are blurred or worn, notably in the left initial area and the line ends; readings are best effort. Ornamental woodcut between the running head and title block is not text. Passage is set in a mixture of roman and italic type; the verse lines are kept as printed.
